title.fr: CCP et RIP (Algérie Poste)

rules.description:
A RIP has 20 digits: bank code 007, branch code 99999, the CCP account number left-padded to 10 digits, and a 2-digit key.
RIP key = 97 − ((account × 100 + offset) mod 97), written on 2 digits. The result is always 01 to 97; 97 is a real key (when the remainder is 0).
CCP key (written after the account number on cheques) = Σ digit × weight, mod 100, where weights run from 4 for the rightmost digit to 13 for the leftmost, on the 10-digit padded account. Written on 2 digits.
Algérie Poste does not publish these algorithms; they are confirmed against real RIP numbers (see vectors/rip.*.json).

triggers: Algérie Poste changes the RIP format

title.fr: Montants en lettres

rules.description: Words used to write DZD amounts on invoices and cheques. French uses the traditional spelling: "vingt" and "cent" take an s only when multiplied and at the end of the number (quatre-vingts, deux cents, but quatre-vingt-un, deux cent mille); "mille" never takes an s; "million" and "milliard" are nouns (deux millions) and take "de" before the currency when nothing follows (un million de dinars). Arabic chooses the form of the counted noun from the last two digits of the number: 1 singular followed by واحد, 2 dual, 3–10 plural (the number takes the ة form), 11–99 singular accusative, otherwise singular. When a number is directly followed by the noun it counts (a scale word such as ألف, or the currency), its last word takes the construct form: the dual loses its ن (مائتا ألف، ألفا دينار، مليونا دينار) and the accusative ألفا / مليونا / مليارا becomes ألف / مليون / مليار (خمسون ألف دينار). Amounts go from 0 to 999 999 999 999.99 DA; zero dinars is written (zéro dinar algérien, صفر دينار جزائري). See OPERATIONS.md for rounding to the centime. The test cases in vectors/words.*.json are the reference.

title.fr: IRG sur les traitements et salaires
title.ar: الضريبة على الدخل الإجمالي على الأجور

rules.description:
Monthly IRG on a regular salary or pension, computed on the monthly taxable income (gross minus the employee's social security contribution):
1. taxable ≤ exemption_threshold → IRG = 0 2. scale_irg = progressive monthly scale (`brackets`, upper bounds in DA, last one null = no limit),
   rounded half up to the centime
3. abatement = scale_irg × abatement.rate, bounded to [abatement.min, abatement.max] 4. irg = scale_irg − abatement 5. if a `smoothing` entry applies to the regime and exemption_threshold < taxable < below:
   irg = irg × multiplier − subtract  (both given as fractions [numerator, denominator])
6. irg = max(0, irg) rounded down to `rounding.step`
Smoothing entries are not cumulative: use the first one whose `regimes` contains the taxpayer's regime. Compute exactly (decimal or rational arithmetic); the only roundings are in steps 2 and 6. See OPERATIONS.md, irg.calculate.

title.fr: Numéros de téléphone

rules.description: ARPCE's national numbering plan. Numbers are written nationally with a leading 0, internationally with +213 and without it. `types` describes each kind of number by its first digit after the 0 and its length (without the 0). `mobile_blocks` and `allocated_blocks` give, as inclusive ranges of the first three digits after the 0, the blocks ARPCE has assigned. Implementations should accept any number of the right shape and report allocation separately, because ARPCE assigns new blocks over time.

versions.notes: Blocks as listed on ARPCE's page updated 11 March 2025. Algeria has no mobile number portability, so the prefix identifies the operator.

title.fr: Plaques d'immatriculation

rules.description: Standard plates read SERIAL-CYY-WW: a chronological serial number, then one group of three digits (vehicle category C followed by the last two digits YY of the year of first registration), then the wilaya code WW. `pattern` is a regular expression for the separated form; `wilaya_codes` lists the codes accepted on plates in that version.

versions.notes: Applies to every plate issued before 2027 under the 1988 rules; the 2023 arrêté kept the layout and added the unknown-year code 33. Codes 59 to 69 are not issued in this period. Codes 49 to 58 appear on plates issued after their wilayas were created.
